thread:
Ravi: Quick question for people-ops Can we carry PTO into next year? Some on my team want to bank days for Q1 launch.
Maya (People Ops): Short: yes. Standard carryover is 40h (5 days) for FT employees; prorated for part-time. Anything above 40h needs manager + People Ops approval.
Zoe: Sick time or comp time count toward that?
Maya (People Ops): No Sick and comp-time are separate buckets and governed by local law. If anyone's outside the US DM me and I'll confirm local rules.
Ravi: What are accrual rates? Also any deadlines to submit requests?
Sam (Payroll): Accruals (US FT): `0-12mo: 80h/yr`, `1-3yr: 120h/yr`, `3+yr: 160h/yr`. Accruals post each pay period. To request carryover, submit a "Carryover Request" in HRIS Time Off by Jan 15.
Maya (People Ops): Note: we snapshot balances on 2024-12-31 23:59 UTC. Approved carryover posts Jan 18. Unapproved excess above the cap will be reduced automatically on Jan 20.
Zoe: Any blackout dates we should be aware of?
Maya (People Ops): Soft blackout for core infra/product during release week Dec 8-14. Company-wide reduced coverage Dec 24-31; staggered rotations OK with manager signoff. Managers should set an approval delegate in HRIS if theyll be OOO.
HRIS Bot: Reminder: update time-off entries before the snapshot: https://redwoodintranet/hr/pto-policy
Ravi: If an emergency occurs and someone needs days before they accrue them, is advanced PTO allowed?
Maya (People Ops): Managers can approve advances up to 40h for emergencies; People Ops + Payroll signoff required for anything beyond that. Advanced balances must be reconciled by end of Q1 via accruals or payroll adjustment.
Ravi: Thanks  will tell the squad to check balances and submit by Jan 15.
